USE [DATA_EXCHANGE]
 ---Test Dates 
 DECLARE @MinDate DATETIME = @Start_Date,
  @MaxDate DATETIME = @End_Date 

--GET MinDate------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF @MinDate = '1/1/1900' OR @MinDate IS NULL OR ISDATE(@MinDate) = 0 
 SET @MinDate = DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, -1, getdate()) - 2, 0) --First day of previous month

--GET MaxDate----------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF @MaxDate = '1/1/1900' OR @MaxDate IS NULL OR ISDATE(@MaxDate) = 0 
    SET @MaxDate = DATEADD(ss, -1, DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, getdate()), 0)) --Last Day of previous month
 --SELECT @MinDate, @MaxDate

IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##EligClaims') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##EligClaims 
 Create Table ##EligClaims 
            (CLCL_ID char(24) , CLCL_CL_SUB_TYPE  char(5),CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT datetime,CLCL_HIGH_SVC_DT datetime, CLCL_PAID_DT datetime, 
			 CLCL_PRPR_ID_REF varchar(40), SBSB_ID varchar(9), GRGR_CK varchar(9), CLCL_PAYEE_PR_ID varchar(12), PRPR_ID varchar(12))

INSERT INTO ##EligClaims
SELECT 
     CLCL.CLCL_ID 
    ,CLCL.CLCL_CL_SUB_TYPE 
	,CLCL.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT  
	,CLCL.CLCL_HIGH_SVC_DT 
	,CLCL.CLCL_PAID_DT  
	,CLCL.CLCL_PRPR_ID_REF
	,CLCL.SBSB_ID
	,CLCL.GRGR_CK
	,CLCL.CLCL_PAYEE_PR_ID 
	,CLCL.PRPR_ID
FROM 
	(select cl.CLCL_ID, cl.CLCL_CL_SUB_TYPE, cl.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT, cl.CLCL_HIGH_SVC_DT, cl.CLCL_PAID_DT, cl.CLCL_PRPR_ID_REF, SBSB.SBSB_ID, CL.GRGR_CK, CL.CLCL_PAYEE_PR_ID
			,cl.PRPR_ID 
	from (
		select CLCL_ID, CSCS_ID, CLCL_CUR_STS, GRGR_CK, MEME_CK, SBSB_CK, CLCL_CL_SUB_TYPE, CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT, CLCL_HIGH_SVC_DT, CLCL_PAID_DT, CLCL_PRPR_ID_REF
			   ,CLCL_PAYEE_PR_ID, PRPR_ID
		from ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM cl WITH(NOLOCK)
			where cl.GRGR_CK = 4 and cl.CLCL_PAID_DT between @MinDate AND @MaxDate
			and cl.CSCS_ID in ('CD01', 'CD02', 'PL01', 'PL02') 
			and cl.CLCL_CUR_STS in ('02', '91', '93', '97', '99')
			and cl.CLCL_CAP_IND IS NOT NULL
			and cl.CLCL_TOT_CHG >= 0
			and cl.CLCL_TOT_PAYABLE >= 0
			and cl.CLCL_CL_SUB_TYPE in ('M', 'H')
	) as cl			
		inner join ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe WITH(NOLOCK) on cl.MEME_CK = mepe.MEME_CK 
			and cl.GRGR_CK = 4
			and mepe.mepe_term_dt >= GETDATE()
			and mepe.mepe_eff_dt <= GETDATE() /*Removes future enrollment periods*/
			and mepe.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'
		inner join ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV mepr WITH(NOLOCK) on cl.MEME_CK = mepr.MEME_CK			
			and mepr.MEPR_PCP_TYPE = 'MP'
			and mepr.MEPR_EFF_DT between mepe.MEPE_EFF_DT and mepe.MEPE_TERM_DT
			and mepr.GRGR_CK = 4
		inner join ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SGSG_SUB_GROUP sg WITH(NOLOCK) on mepe.SGSG_CK = sg.SGSG_CK
			and sg.GRGR_CK = 4
			and sg.SGSG_ID in ('0057', '0220')
        inner join ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC sbsb (NOLOCK) ON cl.SBSB_CK = sbsb.SBSB_CK
			AND sbsb.GRGR_CK = 4
		GROUP BY  cl.CLCL_ID, cl.CLCL_CL_SUB_TYPE, cl.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT, cl.CLCL_HIGH_SVC_DT, cl.CLCL_PAID_DT, cl.CLCL_PRPR_ID_REF, SBSB.SBSB_ID, CL.GRGR_CK, CL.CLCL_PAYEE_PR_ID
			 ,cl.PRPR_ID 
    ) AS CLCL

Create Clustered INDEX IDX_CLCLid on ##EligClaims(CLCL_ID);   
 
--select * from ##EligClaims
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..##DIAG') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE  ##DIAG
CREATE TABLE ##DIAG ([CLCL_ID] varchar (24),DIAG_1_CD varchar (20),DIAG_2_CD varchar (20),DIAG_3_CD varchar (20), DIAG_4_CD varchar (20),DIAG_5_CD varchar (20))

INSERT INTO ##DIAG
        SELECT A.CLCL_ID,
		       MAX(A.DIAG_1_CD) AS DIAG_1_CD,
			   MAX(A.DIAG_2_CD) AS DIAG_2_CD,
			   MAX(A.DIAG_3_CD) AS DIAG_3_CD,
			   MAX(A.DIAG_4_CD) AS DIAG_4_CD,
			   MAX(A.DIAG_5_CD) AS DIAG_5_CD
        FROM 
		(	SELECT CLMD.CLCL_ID,
			CASE WHEN CLMD.CLMD_TYPE='01' THEN CLMD.IDCD_ID END AS DIAG_1_CD
		   ,CASE WHEN CLMD.CLMD_TYPE='02' THEN CLMD.IDCD_ID END AS DIAG_2_CD
		   ,CASE WHEN CLMD.CLMD_TYPE='03' THEN CLMD.IDCD_ID END AS DIAG_3_CD
		   ,CASE WHEN CLMD.CLMD_TYPE='04' THEN CLMD.IDCD_ID END AS DIAG_4_CD
		   ,CASE WHEN CLMD.CLMD_TYPE='05' THEN CLMD.IDCD_ID END AS DIAG_5_CD
		   	FROM [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_CLMD_DIAG] CLMD 
		    WHERE CLMD.CLCL_ID IN  (SELECT DISTINCT CLCL_ID FROM ##EligClaims)  AND CLMD.GRGR_CK='4'	 
         ) AS A
		 GROUP BY CLCL_ID;
		
Create CLUSTEREd inDEX idx_CLCLID1 on ##DIAG(CLCL_ID);

--select * from ##DIAG

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..##PROC') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##PROC
CREATE TABLE ##PROC ([CLCL_ID] varchar (24),[ICD_CM procedure 1] varchar (20),[ICD_CM procedure 2] varchar (20),[ICD_CM procedure 3] varchar (20), [ICD_CM procedure 4] varchar (20),[ICD_CM procedure 5] varchar (20))

INSERT INTO ##PROC
        SELECT A.CLCL_ID, 
				MAX(A.[ICD_CM procedure 1]) AS [ICD_CM procedure 1], 
				MAX(A.[ICD_CM procedure 2]) AS [ICD_CM procedure 2], 
                MAX(A.[ICD_CM procedure 3]) AS [ICD_CM procedure 3], 
				MAX(A.[ICD_CM procedure 4]) AS [ICD_CM procedure 4], 
				MAX(A.[ICD_CM procedure 5]) AS [ICD_CM procedure 5]
		FROM 
		(
			SELECT CLMP.CLCL_ID,
			CASE WHEN CLMP.CLHI_TYPE = 'P' THEN CLMP.IPCD_ID END AS [ICD_CM procedure 1]
		   ,CASE WHEN CLMP.CLHI_TYPE = 'S' THEN CLMP.IPCD_ID END AS [ICD_CM procedure 2]
		   ,CASE WHEN CLMP.CLHI_TYPE = 'T' THEN CLMP.IPCD_ID END AS [ICD_CM procedure 3]
		   ,CASE WHEN CLMP.CLHI_TYPE = '4' THEN CLMP.IPCD_ID END AS [ICD_CM procedure 4]
		   ,CASE WHEN CLMP.CLHI_TYPE = '5' THEN CLMP.IPCD_ID END AS [ICD_CM procedure 5] 

		   FROM [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_CLHI_PROC] CLMP
		   WHERE CLMP.CLCL_ID IN  (SELECT DISTINCT CLCL_ID FROM ##EligClaims) 
	   )AS A
	   GROUP BY CLCL_ID;
		
Create CLUSTEREd inDEX idx_CLCLID2 on ##PROC(CLCL_ID);
 
	WITH CTE_PRRG_BP AS
	( 
	   SELECT A.CLCL_ID, A.PRPR_ID, A.PRRG_ID FROM 
		(
			SELECT DISTINCT PROV.PRPR_ID, PROV.[PRRG_STATE],PROV.[PRRG_EFF_DT],PROV.[PRRG_TERM_DT],PROV.[PRRG_SEQ_NO], PROV.PRAD_TYPE_PRIM, PROV.PRAD_ID, PROV.[PRRG_ID],
				   RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PROV.PRPR_ID ORDER BY PROV.[PRRG_EFF_DT], PROV.[PRRG_SEQ_NO]) AS ROW_NUM, EC.CLCL_ID   
			FROM (
					SELECT  DISTINCT PRPR.PRPR_ID, PRRG.[PRRG_STATE],PRRG.[PRRG_EFF_DT],PRRG.[PRRG_TERM_DT],PRRG.[PRRG_SEQ_NO], PRPR.PRAD_TYPE_PRIM, PRPR.PRAD_ID, PRRG.[PRRG_ID]
					FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRPR_PROV PRPR
					JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRRG_REG PRRG WITH (NOLOCK) ON PRPR.PRCR_ID = PRRG.PRCR_ID and PRRG.PRRG_MCTR_TYPE like '%lic%'  
				 ) AS PROV
			 INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS PRAD ON PRAD.PRAD_TYPE = PROV.PRAD_TYPE_PRIM AND PRAD.PRAD_ID = PROV.PRAD_ID AND PROV.PRRG_STATE = PRAD.PRAD_STATE
			 INNER JOIN ##EligClaims EC ON EC.CLCL_PAYEE_PR_ID = PROV.PRPR_ID AND EC.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT BETWEEN PROV.[PRRG_EFF_DT] AND PROV.[PRRG_TERM_DT] 
	    ) AS A WHERE A.ROW_NUM = 1
	 )
	 ,
	  CTE_PRRG_REF AS
     (
	   SELECT A.CLCL_ID, A.PRPR_ID, A.PRRG_ID FROM 
		(
			SELECT DISTINCT PROV.PRPR_ID, PROV.[PRRG_STATE],PROV.[PRRG_EFF_DT],PROV.[PRRG_TERM_DT],PROV.[PRRG_SEQ_NO], PROV.PRAD_TYPE_PRIM, PROV.PRAD_ID, PROV.[PRRG_ID],
				   RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PROV.PRPR_ID ORDER BY PROV.[PRRG_EFF_DT], PROV.[PRRG_SEQ_NO]) AS ROW_NUM ,EC.CLCL_ID   
			FROM (
					SELECT  DISTINCT PRPR.PRPR_ID, PRRG.[PRRG_STATE],PRRG.[PRRG_EFF_DT],PRRG.[PRRG_TERM_DT],PRRG.[PRRG_SEQ_NO], PRPR.PRAD_TYPE_PRIM, PRPR.PRAD_ID, PRRG.[PRRG_ID]
					FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRPR_PROV PRPR
					JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRRG_REG PRRG WITH (NOLOCK) ON PRPR.PRCR_ID = PRRG.PRCR_ID and PRRG.PRRG_MCTR_TYPE like '%lic%'  
				 ) AS PROV
			 INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS PRAD ON PRAD.PRAD_TYPE = PROV.PRAD_TYPE_PRIM AND PRAD.PRAD_ID = PROV.PRAD_ID AND PROV.PRRG_STATE = PRAD.PRAD_STATE
			 INNER JOIN ##EligClaims EC ON EC.CLCL_PRPR_ID_REF = PROV.PRPR_ID AND EC.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT BETWEEN PROV.[PRRG_EFF_DT] AND PROV.[PRRG_TERM_DT] 
         ) AS A WHERE A.ROW_NUM = 1
	 )


		INSERT INTO [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[TX_NAPI_UTSW_CLAIM_HEADER]
		SELECT DISTINCT
		 EC.SBSB_ID
		,EC.CLCL_ID
		,CTE_PRRG_BP.PRRG_ID
		,PRPR_BP.MCTN_ID
		,CONVERT(VARCHAR,EC.CLCL_PAID_DT, 101)
		,CLHP.CLHP_INPUT_AGRG_ID
		,CLHP.CLHP_FAC_TYPE+CLHP.CLHP_BILL_CLASS+CLHP.CLHP_FREQUENCY AS [Type_Of_Bill]
		,CLHP.CLHP_ADM_TYP AS [Admit Type]       
		,CLHP.CLHP_ADM_SOURCE AS [Admit Source]
		,CLHP.CLHP_ADM_HOUR_CD AS [Admit Hour]
		,CLHP.CLHP_DC_STAT AS [Discharge Status]
		,PRPR_BP.PRPR_NPI 
		,CLHP.CLHP_PRPR_AD_NPI AS [Admitting Provider NPI]
		,PRPR_SR.PRPR_NPI AS [Service Rendering Provider NPI]
		,CLHP.CLHP_PRPR_O1_NPI AS [Other Provider NPI]
		,CTE_PRRG_REF.PRRG_ID AS [Referring Provider License #]
		,CASE WHEN EC.CLCL_CL_SUB_TYPE = 'M' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS [Professional Indicator]
		,PR.[ICD_CM procedure 1]
		,PR.[ICD_CM procedure 2]
		,PR.[ICD_CM procedure 3]
		,PR.[ICD_CM procedure 4]
		,PR.[ICD_CM procedure 5]
		,DIAG.DIAG_1_CD
		,DIAG.DIAG_2_CD
		,DIAG.DIAG_3_CD
		,DIAG.DIAG_4_CD
		,DIAG.DIAG_5_CD
		,CONVERT(VARCHAR,EC.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT, 101)
		,CONVERT(VARCHAR,EC.CLCL_HIGH_SVC_DT, 101)
		,CASE WHEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,CLHP.CLHP_ADM_DT, 101) = '01/01/1753' THEN '' ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR,CLHP.CLHP_ADM_DT, 101) END AS [Admit Date]
		,CASE WHEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,CLHP.CLHP_DC_DT, 101) = '01/01/1753' THEN '' ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR,CLHP.CLHP_DC_DT, 101) END AS [Discharge Date]
		,'FAC'
		,'FAC'

		FROM ##EligClaims EC
			LEFT JOIN [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_PRPR_PROV] PRPR WITH (NOLOCK) ON EC.CLCL_PRPR_ID_REF = PRPR.PRPR_ID
			LEFT JOIN [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_PRRG_REG] PRRG WITH (NOLOCK) ON PRRG.[PRCR_ID] = PRPR.[PRCR_ID] AND PRRG.PRRG_MCTR_TYPE = 'LIC'  
			LEFT JOIN [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_CLHP_HOSP] CLHP WITH (NOLOCK)	ON EC.CLCL_ID = CLHP.CLCL_ID AND EC.GRGR_CK = CLHP.GRGR_CK AND CLHP.GRGR_CK='4'
			LEFT JOIN [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_PRPR_PROV] PRPR_BP WITH (NOLOCK) ON EC.CLCL_PAYEE_PR_ID = PRPR_BP.PRPR_ID	 
			LEFT JOIN [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_PRPR_PROV] PRPR_SR WITH (NOLOCK) ON EC.PRPR_ID = PRPR_SR.PRPR_ID
			LEFT JOIN CTE_PRRG_REF ON CTE_PRRG_REF.CLCL_ID = EC.CLCL_ID
			LEFT JOIN CTE_PRRG_BP ON CTE_PRRG_BP.CLCL_ID = EC.CLCL_ID
			LEFT JOIN ##PROC PR ON PR.CLCL_ID = EC.CLCL_ID
			LEFT JOIN ##DIAG DIAG ON DIAG.CLCL_ID = EC.CLCL_ID

USE [DATA_EXCHANGE]

TRUNCATE TABLE [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[TX_NAPI_UTSW_CLAIM_LINE]

INSERT INTO [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[TX_NAPI_UTSW_CLAIM_LINE]
SELECT  
 CH.[Master Consumer ID]
,CH.[Claim Nbr]
,CDML.[CDML_SEQ_NO]
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CDML.CDML_FROM_DT, 101) 
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CDML.CDML_TO_DT, 101)
,YEAR(CDML.CDML_FROM_DT)
,SUBSTRING(CDML.IPCD_ID,1,5)
,CDML.RCRC_ID
,SUBSTRING(CDML.IPCD_ID,6,2)
,CDML.CDML_UNITS
,CDML.CDML_CHG_AMT
,CDML.PSCD_ID
,CASE WHEN CLHP.CLHP_BILL_CLASS IN ('1','2') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS [Inpatient Flag]
,CASE WHEN DIAG_CD.IDCD_TYPE IN ('I',' ') THEN '9' 
	  WHEN DIAG_CD.IDCD_TYPE = 'T' THEN '10' 
	  ELSE 'UNK' END AS [International Classification of Diseases Version Code]
,'FAC'
,CDML.CDML_UNITS_ALLOW 
,cast(CDML.CDML_TOT_PA_LIAB as decimal (18,2))
,cast(CDML.CDML_ALLOW as decimal (18,2))
,cast(CDML.CDML_PAID_AMT as decimal (18,2))
,CASE WHEN CDML.CDML_CL_NTWK_IND IN ('I','P') THEN 'IN' ELSE 'OUT' END AS [IN and OUT of Network claims]
,CDML.CDML_DISALL_EXCD
,EXPL.EXCD_SHORT_TEXT

FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[TX_NAPI_UTSW_CLAIM_HEADER] CH
	INNER JOIN [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_CDML_CL_LINE] CDML WITH(NOLOCK) ON CH.[Claim Nbr] = CDML.CLCL_ID
	LEFT JOIN [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_IDCD_DIAG_CD] DIAG_CD WITH(NOLOCK) ON CDML.IDCD_ID = DIAG_CD.IDCD_ID AND CDML.CDML_FROM_DT BETWEEN DIAG_CD.IDCD_EFF_DT AND DIAG_CD.IDCD_TERM_DT 
	LEFT JOIN [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_EXCD_EXPL_CD] EXPL WITH(NOLOCK) ON EXPL.EXCD_ID = CDML.[CDML_DISALL_EXCD]
	LEFT JOIN [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_CLHP_HOSP] CLHP WITH(NOLOCK) ON CLHP.CLCL_ID = CDML.CLCL_ID AND CLHP.GRGR_CK = 4
